text: I do not ratify close_above:high_52w_close: with D close_vs_swing_high_pct 2.2 the name is already past the test band, and a new-high trigger buys further away from value (C3, C15). I stand behind WAIT, condition in_zone:structure_shift_ref, trigger h1_close_above:bar_high, a sign-of-strength bar off the test (C7, C12). Raschke's reclaim:structure_shift_ref on H1 also clears my objection: it requires the test of the broken level first, the test-after-breakout trade (C11). Wrong if a daily close under structure_shift_ref.
